verdict.rationale: Skills for Real Engineers is a bundle of SKILL.md instruction files that run inside host agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot. It is not a runtime or agent that could act as an MCP client, so plugging MCP servers into it is a category error. Any MCP-client ability would belong to the host agent, which is a host-platform capability and earns no credit here. Nothing in the evidence shows the bundle itself connecting to or configuring MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
